findings.note: A recent RotoWire/CBS note says Thomas has no significant role in Coen's offense. It lists him with 13 catches on 26 targets in nine games, about 1.4 per game, below the 2+ needed, and says Josh Cameron outproduced him.
ESPN reported about 18 days ago that Lawrence targeted Thomas only nine times in three games, amid trade rumors. Coen still calls him a significant part of the offense.
